name: apiserver_inflight_requests_anomaly
title: API server in-flight requests are unusually high
description: Total in-flight requests on the Kubernetes API server (sum over series of each series' mean apiserver_current_inflight_requests in the bucket) is above its learned weekday/weekend hour-of-day band in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets, a sign of control-plane pressure. Unit: requests. Whole cluster; add a WHERE clause on k8s_cluster inside the subquery after install for a per-cluster alert (one config per cluster). Uses a histogram inside a subquery; keep only after a live _search returns one row per bucket.

anomaly_config.custom_sql: SELECT time_bucket, SUM(v) AS inflight FROM (SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5m') AS time_bucket, __hash__, AVG(value) AS v FROM "apiserver_current_inflight_requests" GROUP BY time_bucket, __hash__) GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket
